Mechanical Engineering World on Instagram: "Barron Trump's new beverage startup, SOLLOS, officially announced its first product lineup ahead of a highly anticipated launch in May. 

Based in Palm Beach near the Mar-a-Lago estate, the company revealed that its flagship offering will be a Pineapple + Coconut flavored Yerba Mate drink, which will be sold in 12-pack cases through their website. 

SEC filings show that the 19-year-old NYU student serves as a director and executive officer for the brand, which successfully raised $1 million in initial funding. 

The startup's name and branding are centered on the "Sunshine State" lifestyle, with the word "SOLLOS" representing the full cycle of the sun from sunrise to sunset.

The venture is a collaborative effort between Barron and several of his former high school classmates from Oxbridge Academy, including Spencer Bernstein and Stephen Hall, both of whom have paused their university studies to lead the brand. 

By focusing on Yerba Mate—a naturally caffeinated herbal tea that is rapidly gaining ground as a healthy coffee alternative—Barron is entering the competitive functional beverage market with a "clean and functional" angle. 

While his father, President Donald Trump, handles international diplomatic and economic affairs, Barron’s move into the retail sector marks his first major independent business endeavor, leveraging a minimalist, sun-inspired aesthetic to attract health-conscious consumers."
